verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile documents built-in delegation to Copilot. Users can start and track Copilot cloud agent tasks from the Agent Tasks view, assign issues to Copilot to get a ready-to-review pull request, iterate via comments, and ask Copilot in natural language to open a pull request, all from within the app. Missing for 10: in-depth mobile-specific documentation beyond marketing-page claims, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent delegation on mobile.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Agent Tasks are now on GitHub Mobile, giving developers a centralized way to manage Copilot cloud agent tasks wherever they are. Easily start new tasks and keep track of progress
Assign issues to Copilot and get a ready-to-review pull request. Use comments to refine, iterate, approve and merge—all directly within GitHub Mobile.
open a new pull request – all in natural language
Assign tasks, review code, and collaborate with Copilot from your mobile device
